expected.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT sp.*, GREATEST(COALESCE(sp.container_qty,1),1) AS qty, UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(sp.freight_term,''))) AS term, (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rates WHERE currency_pair='USD_CNY' AND fetched_at < (sp.etd::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_at, (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rates WHERE currency_pair='USD_CNY' ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS fx_latest FROM shipping_plans sp WHERE sp.etd >= $1::date AND sp.etd < $2::date AND NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL) SELECT bl_no AS customs_no, bl_no, container_no, contract_no, forwarder_cn AS factory_name, forwarder_company_id AS factory_code, pol, pod, etd, term AS freight_term, qty AS container_qty, (term NOT IN ('FOB','FCA')) AS our_ocean_payable, COALESCE(fx_at, fx_latest) AS fx_rate, COALESCE(freight_cost,0) AS ocean_cost_total_usd, ROUND(COALESCE(freight_cost,0) / qty, 2) AS unit_cost_usd, ROUND((CASE WHEN term IN ('FOB','FCA') THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(freight_cost,0) END) * COALESCE(fx_at, fx_latest) + COALESCE(port_surcharge_total,0), 2) AS expected_amount, NULL::timestamptz AS confirmed_at, 'CNY' AS currency FROM base

actual.sql: WITH cand AS (SELECT p.*, COALESCE(p.this_amount,p.amount,p.paid_amount) AS pay_amount, UPPER(CONCAT_WS(' ', p.pay_item, p.pay_type, p.bank_ref, p.raw->>'bl_no', p.raw->>'note', p.raw->>'memo', p.raw->>'remark')) AS stext FROM finance_payments p WHERE p.direction IN ('out','AP','付款') AND COALESCE(p.status,'') NOT IN ('voided','cancelled','已退回','已冲销') AND (p.pay_item IN ('freight','运费','ocean_freight') OR p.pay_type IN ('货代海运费','货代港杂费','货代物流费') OR p.pay_item ILIKE '%海运%' OR p.pay_item ILIKE '%运费%' OR NULLIF(p.raw->>'bl_no','') IS NOT NULL)), src AS (SELECT 1 srank, p.id payment_id, sp.bl_no, p.payment_date, p.pay_amount actual_amount, p.pay_item, p.pay_type, 'plan_id' match_source FROM cand p JOIN shipping_plans sp ON (sp.id::text=p.plan_id::text OR sp._id::text=p.plan_id::text) WHERE NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 2, p.id, sp.bl_no, p.payment_date, p.pay_amount, p.pay_item, p.pay_type, 'raw_bl_no' FROM cand p JOIN shipping_plans sp ON UPPER(sp.bl_no)=UPPER(NULLIF(p.raw->>'bl_no','')) WHERE NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 3, p.id, sp.bl_no, p.payment_date, p.pay_amount, p.pay_item, p.pay_type, 'text_bl' FROM cand p JOIN shipping_plans sp ON UPPER(sp.bl_no) = (regexp_match(p.stext, '(?:BL|B/L|提单号?)[:：# ]*([A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9/-]{5,30})'))[1] WHERE NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT ON (payment_id, bl_no) bl_no, payment_id, payment_date, actual_amount, pay_item, pay_type, match_source FROM src WHERE COALESCE(actual_amount,0) > 0 ORDER BY payment_id, bl_no, srank
